name: AGENTS Root Instructions
primary_use: Root repository operating contract for agents and builders.
known_limits: Project-specific behavior still depends on profiles, blueprints, and prompts loaded after the root instructions.
output_contract: Intake, specification, Vertical Blueprint, plan, tasks, validation, scorecard.

name: Claude Code
primary_use: Long-running coding agent sessions with explicit repository ingestion.
known_limits: Tool behavior and context retention depend on the local Claude Code environment.
output_contract: Intake, specification, Vertical Blueprint, plan, tasks, validation, scorecard.
notes: Use with the repository loaded into the workspace.

name: Codex
primary_use: Terminal-first coding agent execution with repository-native prompts and validation.
known_limits: Tool access and sandbox behavior depend on the local Codex configuration.
output_contract: Intake, specification, Vertical Blueprint, plan, tasks, validation, scorecard.
notes: Use when the repository itself should govern the agent workflow.

name: Copilot
primary_use: IDE-assisted coding sessions constrained by the repository method.
known_limits: Behavior depends on editor integration and prompt surface exposed by the host.
output_contract: Intake, specification, Vertical Blueprint, plan, tasks, validation, scorecard.
notes: Pair with the GitHub Copilot instruction file for editor-native behavior.

name: Gemini CLI
primary_use: CLI-driven coding and builder orchestration with explicit artifact gates.
known_limits: Command and tool semantics depend on the local Gemini CLI environment.
output_contract: Intake, specification, Vertical Blueprint, plan, tasks, validation, scorecard.

name: Grok
primary_use: General coding-agent sessions that still need repository-level method control.
known_limits: Capabilities vary by host environment and connected tools.
output_contract: Intake, specification, Vertical Blueprint, plan, tasks, validation, scorecard.

name: Windsurf
primary_use: Editor-native agent sessions with repository-ingested execution rules.
known_limits: Context injection and tool behavior depend on the editor host.
output_contract: Intake, specification, Vertical Blueprint, plan, tasks, validation, scorecard.

name: Generic Agent
primary_use: Fallback adapter for agents without a dedicated repository-specific instruction file.
known_limits: Generic agents may require more explicit prompt framing to respect the full pipeline.
output_contract: Intake, specification, Vertical Blueprint, plan, tasks, validation, scorecard.

name: Builder Ingestion
primary_use: Direct ingestion for app builders and product generators that accept long-form instructions.
known_limits: Builder products may compress context and silently default to templates if the contract is not enforced.
output_contract: Intake, specification, Vertical Blueprint, plan, tasks, validation, scorecard.
notes: Use for builder-style products rather than terminal coding agents.

name: GitHub Copilot Instructions
primary_use: Repository-scoped Copilot instruction surface for GitHub and IDE integrations.
known_limits: Instruction support depends on the Copilot host and repository integration mode.
output_contract: Intake, specification, Vertical Blueprint, plan, tasks, validation, scorecard.

name: GitHub Copilot Path Instructions
primary_use: Path-specific Copilot instruction layer for docs, Python tooling, benchmarks, blueprints, prompts, scorecards, and skills.
known_limits: Path instruction support depends on the GitHub Copilot host and editor integration.
output_contract: Targeted repository edits that preserve naming, pipeline, validation, and anti-genericity constraints.

name: GitHub Actions Validation
primary_use: CI validation for repository structure, doctor checks, harness fixtures, schemas, extension catalog, and preset catalog.
known_limits: CI is structural and deterministic; it does not prove semantic product quality.
output_contract: Passing lint, doctor, harness, blueprint score, and JSON validation checks.
notes: Uses standard GitHub checkout and Python setup actions only.

name: GitHub Pull Request Template
primary_use: Contributor checklist for preserving pipeline, naming, anti-genericity, validation, fixtures, and discovery-only catalogs.
known_limits: Human contributors must still run and report validation honestly.
output_contract: Pull request description with checked methodology and validation evidence.

name: Codespaces Devcontainer
primary_use: Optional GitHub Codespaces or devcontainer setup for Python-based repository validation.
known_limits: Optional contributor convenience only; GitHub is not required to use the methodology.
output_contract: Environment that can run python3 tools/sdc.py doctor --quick and make harness.
notes: No runtime dependency is added to the repository.

name: App Builder Usage Plugin
primary_use: Usage overlay for builder products that need tighter anti-genericity constraints.
known_limits: This is an adapter layer; it does not replace blueprint, plan, or scorecard artifacts.
output_contract: Intake, specification, Vertical Blueprint, plan, tasks, validation, scorecard.

name: Cursor Rules Plugin
primary_use: Instruction bridge for Cursor-style repository rules and prompt routing.
known_limits: Cursor host behavior may still add editor-side defaults outside repository control.
output_contract: Intake, specification, Vertical Blueprint, plan, tasks, validation, scorecard.

name: Claude Code Skills Plugin
primary_use: Maps repository workflows to skill-oriented Claude Code sessions.
known_limits: Assumes the host can load or approximate skill-style workflows.
output_contract: Intake, specification, Vertical Blueprint, plan, tasks, validation, scorecard.

name: MCP Tooling Plugin
primary_use: Adapter for MCP-enabled agents and tool servers that need explicit repository contracts.
known_limits: Actual tool safety and capability depend on the connected MCP server set.
output_contract: Intake, specification, Vertical Blueprint, plan, tasks, validation, scorecard.

name: Toolkit Adapter Plugin
primary_use: Cross-tool adapter for routing the repository command model into external builder surfaces.
known_limits: This layer standardizes ingestion; it does not evaluate semantic product quality.
output_contract: Intake, specification, Vertical Blueprint, plan, tasks, validation, scorecard.

name: AGENTS.md Plugin
primary_use: Compatibility adapter for ecosystems that expect AGENTS.md-style repository instructions.
known_limits: Acts as a bridge, not a replacement for the root repository instructions.
output_contract: Intake, specification, Vertical Blueprint, plan, tasks, validation, scorecard.
